title: Exact colimits pass to functor categories
statement: Let $J$ and $I$ be small categories and let $\mathcal A$ be a category with finite limits and colimits of shape $I$. Suppose the colimit functor $\operatorname{colim}_I:\operatorname{Fun}(I,\mathcal A)\to\mathcal A$ preserves finite limits. Then the colimit functor $\operatorname{colim}_I:\operatorname{Fun}(I,\operatorname{Fun}(J,\mathcal A))\to\operatorname{Fun}(J,\mathcal A)$ also preserves finite limits. In particular this applies to each small filtered $I$ for which $\mathcal A$ has exact filtered colimits. Colimits and their structure maps are as in [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]; a coproduct is the colimit of the discrete diagram of its summands.
